This page sets out the exercise, task by task, with the tool in which each task is done. The [background page](../../background.qmd) presents the original study, the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026) and the five reanalyses. The tasks are done in the IDE workspace, in your IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), and the slides and the [webR workspace](../../lab.qmd) carry the work if your installation fails.

## The tasks {#the-tasks}

The full-day format takes all five tasks, Task 1 in Part 1, Task 2 in Part 2, Task 3 in Part 3, and Tasks 4 and 5 in Part 4. The report of the IDE workspace, `index.qmd`, holds the steps of each task.
